ownerPolicy.statement: Missing Diplomat encounters credit all five simultaneously. Include common party dialogue, lectures and scripted events; wait for every player to receive credit.
ownerPolicy.scope: The participation policy makes no additional duration, death-count or observed-payout claim. Separately typed scripted-combat proofs retain explicit captured death counters; conversation, supply, capture and escort counters do not invent creature deaths.

instantHandInEvidence.sourceBehavior: The captured native source contains turnin 1267 after 1324, with no accept or completion command. Preserve this reward-only interaction, without inventing a pickup.

Kill Vale Screechers and Rogue Vale Screechers
Use [Yeh'kinya's Bramble] on their corpses to summon a Screecher Spirit
